summary: This sermon teaches that biblical generosity begins with understanding that God owns everything and we are stewards, not owners. The speaker challenges the congregation to shift from ownership thinking to caretaking, emphasizing that giving should flow from a surrendered heart rather than religious duty or the expectation of return.
key_points: God is the owner; we are caretakers and stewards of His resources
Jesus flips the master-servant paradigm by serving those who faithfully steward what He entrusts
Giving should be regular, proportional, sacrificial, voluntary, joyful, and motivated by discipleship to Jesus
Reject prosperity gospel (give-to-get); God blesses us to give more, not just have more
Practice listening to the Spirit about how to use resources
big_idea: All we have belongs to God, and we are called to be faithful stewards and caretakers of His resources, giving generously from hearts surrendered to Him rather than from obligation or expectation of return.
title: GENEROSITY: All We Have Belongs to God
